record.title: CELL2 compose/expand fanout handoff
record.body: CELL2 did not restart discovery. It consumed Project2 current topology and revalidated only stale consumer subjects whose shared producer repair had become assimilated. Strongest canonical path remains ExistingPackReuse/Composition: exact admitted forced-top25-admissibility-factory-pack at ggen-marketplace@a658cda7066bba344e481173b5b52a0dc18c5c75 -> exact target RDF -> real ggen sync run -> generated consequence -> exact-head consumer court -> default assimilation. Three consumers were regenerated with six downstream commits and are now requalifying in parallel.
